purpose: Photographic replacements derived from the original concepts: straight repeatable ceramic bays, asanoha wood joinery, engraved gilt fittings, woven silk, gold leaf, washi, and lacquer.
processing: scripts/prepare_materials.py crops the repeat bounds of single straight ceramic and kumiko cells and exposure-balanced paper (no perspective warping), retains alpha, rotates lacquer grain, packs the flower repeat and encodes WebP at quality 93. Roof: 512px wide; kumiko: 600px wide; silk: 768px wide; paper: 1012px crop; other surfaces: original resolution. No vector or procedural substitutes.

textures.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: photographic wooden lattice material for the narrow transom at the top of the live website.
Input image 1 is the edit source. Extract ONLY the Japanese asanoha wooden lattice in its upper-left quadrant, removing the thick outside posts, outer framing, paper wall and all other quadrants. The real fine wood grain and neatly fitted joinery in that concept are the quality benchmark. Image 2 shows the whole website and is only a guide to the slender decorative band and its existing sixfold hexagonal pattern.
Produce a wide landscape 3:1 photograph of the lattice alone, filling the whole image edge to edge. TRUE ORTHOGRAPHIC FRONT VIEW: every matching member is parallel, equal pitch, no vanishing point or fanning. A precise repeating asanoha hemp-leaf pattern: regular hexagonal sixfold star cells subdivided into slim triangular leaves by straight, neatly jointed wooden strips. Exactly three complete sixfold cells across the width, with matching partial cells at the top and bottom where the repeating field continues. Opposite left/right edges match exactly in pattern phase, pitch, height and illumination so this is a horizontal repeat material. No external border or vertical divider between cells.
Natural softly aged hinoki/cedar wood, warm restrained honey-brown rather than bright gold, 2–3 mm wide front faces, tiny chamfered arrises, visible darker side faces giving each wooden strip actual thickness, very fine grain ALIGNED WITH EACH INDIVIDUAL STRUT. Sharp hand-cut half-lap/miter joints with tiny dark seams and wood end grain at the intersections; well maintained precise craftsmanship, no gaps or warping, no extra sticks. Real upper-left daylight glints gently on the wood's top-left edges; lower-right side faces are darker. Real focus-stacked macro architectural photography.
Every triangular opening is FULLY TRANSPARENT alpha, so the website can place softly lit paper behind the lattice. No opaque black, white or gray in the holes; no glass, cloth or paper. Preserve the material's tiny self-shadows on wooden side faces, but no cast shadows baked into a background. No solid backing, no checkerboard, no external shadow or margins.
Avoid vector linework, wires, metallic/golden rods, extruded plastic, smooth CGI gradients, fake noise, ornamental flowers, random triangles or fivefold stars, bent members, perspective drift, mismatched repetition, typography and watermark. This must read as miniature actual wooden joinery, not an illustration.
textures.integration: One orthographic cell repeats horizontally at its natural aspect ratio, 36 CSS pixels high; a separate recessed washi backing and CSS cast shadows remain visible through the alpha openings.

textures.prompt:

Its left and right outlines run parallel without converging, slanting, tapering or fanning. True orthographic long-lens elevation: no perspective vanishing point, no lens distortion. Keep the top and bottom of the circular medallion aligned with the exact central x-axis. The disc is round, its face parallel to the image plane.
The side pan tiles extend all the way to both canvas edges, cut at matching MIDPOINTS of identical troughs. Roof starts at the top canvas edge and fills the upper 90% of the image; only the bottom 10% and the area beneath the scallop are transparent.
Preserve the reference's real photographic ceramic: silver charcoal gray fired clay, fine pitting, carbon sheen, subtle mineral grain, softly worn lips, thick hand-molded tile edges, scrollwork incised into the pan lips, the molded three-comma crest, convincing dark overlap gaps. Maintained craftsmanship, clean regular silhouette, no broken/chipped edges. Soft directional daylight from upper left. Focus-stacked architectural macro photograph, not a rendering or drawing.
Most important: ONE TILE BAY, perfectly vertical central ridge, horizontally seamless, TRUE ALPHA under the roof. No diagonal long axes. No fan shape. No multiple bays. No wood, text, background, checkerboard, white margin, border or watermark.

Six shallow flat lobed petals, delicate raised outer border, six small punched dots, intricate fine incised radial linework and tiny stippling, round central nail head. seam_repair.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: an existing photographic kozo washi texture used as a repeating website background.
Input image 1 is the exact edit target. Repair only its uneven exposure and its tile boundaries. Preserve this exact fine, dense, ivory paper character, crisp microscopic short fibers, fiber scale, softness and natural translucency. Do not redesign the paper.
The current right edge is about 5 RGB levels darker than the left edge and the lower edge is slightly darker than the top. These cause obvious straight seams when the image repeats. Remove all low-frequency left-to-right and top-to-bottom exposure/color drift. A neutral, spatially uniform ivory base near RGB (233,226,217), with natural fine-scale variations only. No baked-in broad lighting, vignetting, warm/cool edge cast or cloud-shaped patches. Lighting for the final page is provided separately.
Make this a genuinely seamless periodic square texture in BOTH axes: left and right edge exposure, color, grain density and fibers must continue exactly into each other; the same is true of the top and bottom edges, including all four corners. Imagine a 3-by-3 tiled grid; no line or color step should reveal any tile boundary. Balanced identical average exposure at all four edges and through the center. Do not put a rim, fade-to-white band, blurred edge or blank margin around the image.
Full-bleed square orthographic macro photograph of refined handmade ivory washi. Sharp fine fibers, restrained natural micro relief. Preserve the grain and color character of the supplied photograph. No folds, stains, large strands, large knots, linen weave, diagonal lighting, global gradients, borders, grid, text or objects. Output only one seamless texture tile.
seam_repair.integration: Exposure-balanced photograph cropped at measured matching edge tones on both axes. CSS repeats rescaled in proportion to the crop to retain the fine grain size; room illumination and paper veil unchanged. No blur, mirroring, or procedural texture.

textures.prompt:

Asset type: a small isolated architectural material for a photoreal website's Chinese roof support band.
A single real traditional Chinese wooden dougong bracket, straight-on true orthographic frontal elevation, symmetric, no perspective convergence. Simple early/Tang-style three-tier interlocking bracket assembly: a broad shallow top bearing timber, two shorter stepped arms below, and a compact rectangular bearing block at bottom center. Real wood members with restrained rounded/chamfered ends and tight joinery. Low wide silhouette, approximately 3.2 times as wide as tall. The whole bracket supports an unseen roof above; no roof, wall, column, pedestal or surrounding scene is included.
Material: deep warm vermilion red lacquer over fine wooden grain, beautifully maintained, tiny natural pores and brush traces, soft worn arrises, narrow realistic joints, no gold paint, no ornamental carvings. It must look like an actual small timber bracket photographed with a macro architectural lens, not a flat icon or CG plastic. Soft daylight from upper left: small natural highlights on the top-left arrises, darker underside and inner joints, subtle red reflected light. Even focus across the piece. No broad black shadow baked around the silhouette.
Composition: one complete bracket alone, horizontal top edge, centered on a wide transparent canvas with a little transparent padding. Every exterior gap is fully transparent, true RGBA. No checkerboard, no white background, no text, no watermark, no multiple separate brackets or repeated strip. Fine enough photographic detail to remain convincing when this asset is reduced to a 20px-high website detail.
textures.integration: Photographic vermilion timber supports replace the old flat black dougong mask. One alpha-preserving support per three ceramic tile bays; light grading and a small cast shadow are separate CSS effects. Cropping, resizing and repeat-strip packing only.
